name: Manaus
source: Agencia Nacional de Aguas e Saneamento Basico (ANA), HidroWeb web service
datum: cm above the Manaus port staff gauge zero, a local arbitrary reference; SGB says to subtract 7.00 m from a reading to refer it to sea level (SGB Amazonas bulletin, 19 May 2017)
license: No license on the HidroWeb service itself. The SNIRH metadata record for the national hydrometric network allows reproduction of the data provided the source is cited (https://metadados.snirh.gov.br/geonetwork/srv/api/records/f85dbf06-a869-414c-afc5-bb01869e9156). Credit: Agencia Nacional de Aguas e Saneamento Basico (ANA), HidroWeb.
notes: Datum check: 2274 days where both the historic series and telemetry have a value (2005-06-30 to 2014-12-30); telemetry daily mean minus historic value: median +0.0 cm, mean +1.2 cm, 5th-95th percentile -7.5 to +5.0 cm. A median near zero means the two share the same gauge zero.

Historic series: ANA HidroSerieHistorica, tipoDados=1 (stage). Where a month exists at consistency level 2 (consistent, reviewed by ANA) we use it; otherwise level 1 (raw) and mark it provisional. Last level-2 date: 2014-12-30. Level-1 days used: 0.

Per-day status codes from ANA (CotaNNStatus): 251 days flagged 2 'estimated' are marked estimated; 0 days flagged 3 'doubtful' and 0 days flagged 4 'dry staff gauge' are kept as published with their consistency-level quality.

Daily value: ANA's daily-mean row where published (normally the mean of the 07:00 and 17:00 staff readings); otherwise the mean of the reading rows for that day. Days by source row: {'daily_mean_row': 41009}.

Historic record ends 2014-12-30. Days after that come from the ANA telemetry feed (DadosHidrometeorologicos, mostly 15-minute readings), averaged to a daily mean (4255 days, marked provisional). Telemetry days with fewer than 12 readings: 172. Dropped as partial days (fewer than 75% of the readings the gauge usually sends per day, the median over the 61 days around it): 57, most recent 2026-02-21, 2026-02-22, 2026-02-23, 2026-02-24, 2026-10-20.
No fill values found in this series; ANA leaves missing days blank.

measurement_history.fact: Rio Negro levels at the port of Manaus have been measured daily since September 1902.
ANA inventory lists the staff gauge series from 1902-09-01 to 2014-06-01; the ANA historic file used here has reviewed values to 2014-12-30.
ANA inventory: telemetry starts 2001-06-01, so it overlaps the staff gauge series.

Join: this file uses the reviewed staff gauge series through 2014-12-30 and telemetry daily means from 2015-01-01. On 2,274 days in 2005-2014 that have both, telemetry minus staff gauge has a median of 0 cm and yearly medians between -1.2 and 0 cm, so the two share the same gauge zero and the join is continuous.
measurement_history.source: derived from ANA HidroSerieHistorica and DadosHidrometeorologicos, station 14990000

measurement_history.fact: SGB: Manaus levels use a local, arbitrary reference tied to the port staff gauge; subtract 7.00 m from a reading to refer it to sea level.
Not found: who reads the port gauge and at what hour, any documented gauge move or zero change, a CPRM note giving 6.83 m instead of 7.00 m (could not be opened).

public_notes: The Manaus gauge has been read daily at the port since 1902. Since 2015 the values come from an automatic sensor and have not yet been reviewed; we checked ten years where both exist and they agree to within about a centimeter on a typical day.
